# Brand guidelines: Tidewater Plumbing

## Source assets

| Asset | File (in assets/ or brand/assets/) | Origin (owner supplied, extracted from live site) |
|---|---|---|
| Logo | brand/assets/logo.svg | owner supplied, 2026-09-28 |
| Van photo | assets/van-and-plumber.jpg | owner supplied, 2026-09-28 |

## Logo

One horizontal SVG logo in navy, plus a white version for dark backgrounds. Minimum width 120 px, clear space equal to the height of the wave mark.

## Color

| Token | Hex | Used for | Contrast vs background |
|---|---|---|---|
| --color-bg | #ffffff | page background | n/a |
| --color-text | #14213d | body text | 15.9:1 |
| --color-primary | #c2410c | primary CTA only | 5.2:1 with white text |

## Typography

| Role | Family | Weight | Size (mobile / desktop) | Line height |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| H1 | system-ui | 700 | 2rem / 3.5rem | 1.1 |
| Body | system-ui | 400 | 1rem / 1.125rem | 1.6 |

Font loading: system stack, nothing to load.

## Spacing and layout

Spacing scale 4, 8, 16, 24, 40, 64 px; content max width 72rem; sections padded 40 px on mobile and 64 px on desktop.

## Hero pattern

Headline top left, proof directly under the subheadline, CTA button below the proof, photo on the right on desktop and below the CTA on mobile.

## Components

Primary button in the primary color with a visible 3 px focus ring; secondary links underlined in text color. Proof cards on a light surface with the attribution in muted text.

## Imagery

Real photos of the team, vans and finished jobs from assets/. No stock photos of smiling models holding wrenches.

## Motion

Buttons lift 1 px on hover over 200 ms; nothing else moves. With prefers-reduced-motion the transition is removed.

## Voice

A calm neighbor who knows pipes. Short sentences, prices in numbers, no hype.

## Do and do not

| Do | Do not |
|---|---|
| Show the fixed price promise next to every CTA | Use the primary color for anything but the CTA |
